name: IRR 内部收益率计算器

map.计算投资项目的内部收益率、净现值、投资回收期，支持自定义现金流: Compute an investment project's internal rate of return, net present value and payback period, with custom cash flows
map.求 IRR 使 NPV = Σ CFₜ/(1+r)ᵗ = 0（含 t=0 初始投: Find the IRR that makes NPV = Σ CFₜ/(1+r)ᵗ = 0 (including t=0 initial investment); payback = the period when cumulative cash flow turns positive
map.基于内部收益率定义：IRR 为使净现值为零的折现率，用迭代法求解；同时给出 NP: Based on the IRR definition: IRR is the discount rate that makes the net present value zero, solved by iteration; also gives NPV and payback; the cash flow must change sign, otherwise it may be unsolvable.
map.：使净现值为零的折现率，反映投资真实回报率: : the discount rate that makes NPV zero, reflecting the investment's real return
map.• IRR > 折现率：项目可行，值得投资: • IRR > discount rate: project feasible, worth investing
map.• IRR < 折现率：项目不可行，不建议投资: • IRR < discount rate: project infeasible, not recommended
map.：未来现金流折现到现在的价值总和: : the sum of future cash flows discounted to present
map.• NPV = 0：刚好达到预期收益率: • NPV = 0: just meets the expected return rate
map.CFt：第t期现金流，r：折现率，t：期数: CFt: cash flow at period t, r: discount rate, t: period
map.注：本工具使用牛顿迭代法计算 IRR，结果仅供参考，不构成投资建议。: Note: this tool uses Newton's iteration to compute IRR; results are for reference only, not investment advice.
map.📚 深度解析：内部收益率 IRR: 📚 Deep Dive: Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
map.评估不规则现金流项目的真实回报: Assess the real return of irregular-cash-flow projects
map.判断项目是否值得做: Judge whether a project is worth doing
map.IRR 是使: IRR is the discount rate that makes
map.NPV=0 的折现率：使「各期现金流按该率贴现后之和=0」。NPV=Σ CF_t: NPV=0: the rate at which 'the sum of each period's cash flow discounted at that rate = 0'. NPV=Σ CF_t/(1+r)^t, solve r so NPV=0. Feasible if above the required return.
map.现金流符号多次变号（如 - + - +）可能产生多个 IRR，此时用修正 IRR: Cash flows changing sign multiple times (e.g. - + - +) may yield multiple IRRs; then use the modified IRR (MIRR) or weigh NPV more for decisions.
map.ROI 是总收益/成本，忽略时间；IRR 把时间价值纳入，反映「年化」回报，更适: ROI is total gain/cost, ignoring time; IRR incorporates time value, reflecting the 'annualized' return, better for cross-period unequal cash-flow comparison.
map.它隐含「中间现金流以 IRR 再投资」的假设，且多变号现金流会多解；大额非常规项: It implicitly assumes intermediate cash flows are reinvested at the IRR, and multi-sign cash flows give multiple solutions; large unconventional projects should be judged with NPV and payback together.
